hero_subtitle: Enter your ID — the server is ready. No need to search around.
feature_1_desc: Send your game ID — the bot instantly tells you which server you're on. No waiting.
feature_2_desc: Enter your Moonton email — we will send the official new password form to your inbox.
feature_3_desc: Rank, heroes, stats — all in one message. Discover your hidden arsenal.
feature_4_desc: Type @checkmlbbidBot + ID in any chat. Check without leaving the conversation.
step_2_desc: Enter game ID or ID + Server
step_3_desc: Server, rank, heroes — everything is ready
cta_desc: Open the bot in Telegram and run your first check. Free, fast, convenient.
footer_text: An independent bot for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.
footer_disclaimer: The bot is not affiliated with Moonton.
faq_1_a: Server detection usually finishes within 1-3 seconds. We use the Telegram API and MLBB API in parallel.
faq_2_a: Yes, the bot is completely free. No hidden payments.
faq_3_q: What languages does it work in?
faq_3_a: It works in Uzbek, Russian and English. The language can be changed anytime in the bot.
faq_4_a: Yes. The bot only uses the game ID; your personal data is not stored.
faq_5_q: Do I need to join a group?
faq_5_a: Sometimes a mandatory group may be set up. This is required for the bot to work.
